title.en: MCP Model Input: Sampling Migration and Stateless MRTR

hook: MCP 2026-07-28 deprecates Sampling for new designs and removes the server-to-client request channel. If an existing workflow still needs the client's model, the server returns an `input_required` result and the client retries the original request with the model output. The reasoning loop becomes explicit, bounded, and stateless at the protocol layer.
